name: B1·3 Reputation Engine — new review alert + AI reply draft + weekly report (3 automations combined)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — step by step
1. Get your Google **Place ID**: developers.google.com/maps/documentation/places → 'Place ID Finder' → search your showroom → copy ID → set variable **PLACE_ID**.
2. Get a **Google Maps API key** (Places API enabled, free tier fine) → variable **MAPS_API_KEY**.
3. Set **GEMINI_API_KEY** (aistudio.google.com) and **TG_OWNER_CHAT_ID**; attach Telegram credential.
4. Attach Google Sheets credential; make a tab **Reviews** (Time, Author, Rating, Text, Replied).
5. Activate. It checks reviews every 6 h; new ones → Telegram alert with an AI-drafted reply you can paste into Google. Sunday 19:00 → weekly reputation report.

## 🔧 FIX
• Empty result → Places API not enabled on the key, or wrong PLACE_ID.
• Only 5 reviews visible → Google API limit; newest still detected via 'time' field.
• AI reply too long → edit the prompt in 'Gemini: draft reply'.
